purpose: Provide host-neutral hook transport normalization plus versioned protocol-shape negotiation, canonical event/decision routing, compatibility response encoders, explicit shape lifecycle (catalog/validation/proof/routing) validation, deterministic sampling and certification, and privacy-safe shape/version evidence without embedding consumer policy.

runtime_boundary.privacy: Protocol observations persist structural key/type fingerprints, host family/event/version hints, and hashes only; payload values are not persisted.

non_goals: own prompt registries or prompt semantics
assume one immutable hook shape per host product
guess unknown host schemas from payload values
cross-hybridize unrelated host families without explicit compatibility evidence
promote synthetic negotiation to live host acceptance
silently promote a PROSPECTIVE candidate over a regressed ACTIVE shape
let historical version/shape bindings authorize current automatic switching
proof_ceiling: Synthetic tests prove protocol profile validation, shape fingerprinting, lifecycle validation, routing eligibility ceilings, config projection, admitted hybrid response encoding, and positive/negative sampling sensitivity. Live host canary evidence is required before automatic switching is production-proven.
